toolOfTheDay.name: SWE-bench Verified
toolOfTheDay.summary: Human-verified subset of 500 real-world GitHub issues and unit test pull requests used to evaluate autonomous software engineering AI agents. The corpus spans 500 verified GitHub issues of verified and structured training and evaluation samples. It serves as an authoritative benchmark for evaluating The global gold standard benchmark for Devin, Claude 3.7 Sonnet, and autonomous coding agents. Released under the MIT license for open evaluation and research reproducibility.
toolOfTheDay.architecture: Dockerized reproducible environment harness across 12 major Python repositories.
toolOfTheDay.usage:
from datasets import load_dataset
ds = load_dataset("princeton-nlp/SWE-bench_Verified", split="test")
toolOfTheDay.benchmarks: The global gold standard benchmark for Devin, Claude 3.7 Sonnet, and autonomous coding agents.
toolOfTheDay.limitations: Requires Dockerized test harness execution for each evaluated issue.
